summary: 罗马的塞斯提乌斯金字塔是一座受埃及风格影响的古墓。文章追溯其造型、位置和幸存原因，再说明现代交通与环境造成的损伤如何促成修复与后续维护。
logic: 征服埃及后的建筑风尚
比较金字塔造型与罗马墓葬位置

paragraphs.brief: 虽然罗马吸引了世界各地的游客到其许多令人印象深刻的地点，但那里一个引人注目的纪念碑却从未引起过如此多的兴趣：凯斯提乌斯金字塔。
sentences: Though Rome draws tourists from around the world to its many impressive sites, one notable monument there has never attracted nearly as much interest: the Pyramid of Cestius.
虽然罗马吸引了世界各地的游客到其许多令人印象深刻的地点，但那里一个引人注目的纪念碑却从未引起过如此多的兴趣：凯斯提乌斯金字塔。
But why would there be a pyramid in Italy?
但为什么意大利会有金字塔？
After the Roman conquest of Egypt in 30 B.C., Egyptian architectural style became the fashion in Rome.
在公元前30年罗马征服埃及之后，埃及建筑风格成为了罗马的时尚。

paragraphs.brief: 虽然埃及巨大的金字塔所启发的方尖碑和其他纪念碑在城市周围涌现，但据知只有两座实际的金字塔已经建成。
sentences: Though obelisks and other monuments inspired by Egypt’s great pyramids sprang up around the city, only two actual pyramids are known to have been built.
虽然埃及巨大的金字塔所启发的方尖碑和其他纪念碑在城市周围涌现，但据知只有两座实际的金字塔已经建成。

The only one left standing, the Pyramid of Cestius, was designed as the burial pyramid for a Roman politician named Caius Cestius, who ordered that the building work be completed within a period of 330 days.
唯一剩下的一个，凯斯提乌斯金字塔，被设计为罗马政治家凯斯凯斯提厄斯的墓地金字塔。他下令在330天内完成建筑工程。

Construction took place at some point between 18 B.C. and 12 B.C. Cestius’ pyramid had a layer of white Carrara marble on the outside, and was constructed from brick held together by a basic kind of cement on the inside.
Cestius的金字塔在公元前18年到公元前12年之间建造时，外面有一层白色的Carrara大理石，用内装基本水泥的砖头建造。
One of the things that strikes you when you look at the pyramid is how steep it is, so that the shape of Cestius’ pyramid is quite unlike that of typical Egyptian ones.
当你看到金字塔时，你所看到的一个东西就是它有多陡峭，所以凯斯提乌斯金字塔的形状与典型的埃及金字塔完全不同。
This is a difference that could have been the result of inaccurate information sent back to Rome by soldiers who saw the pyramids in person in Egypt.
这可能是由亲眼看到埃及金字塔的士兵向罗马发送不准确信息的结果。
Alternatively, Roman builders could have drawn inspiration from the pyramids in Nubia, a region located in what is today northern Sudan and southern Egypt.
或者，罗马建筑商本可以从位于当今苏丹北部和埃及南部的努比亚的金字塔中汲取灵感。

paragraphs.brief: 在建造时，由于罗马法律严格禁止在该市内安放坟墓，凯斯底斯金字塔本来会留在农村。
sentences: At the time of its construction, since there was a strict Roman law prohibiting the placement of tombs within the city itself, the Pyramid of Cestius would have stood in the countryside.
在建造时，由于罗马法律严格禁止在该市内安放坟墓，凯斯底斯金字塔本来会留在农村。
Rome grew enormously during the next two centuries, and, by the 3rd century A.D., the pyramid would have been surrounded by buildings.
罗马在接下来的两百年里大幅增长到了公元三世纪金字塔就会被建筑包围

We also know that in the 3rd century A.D., the Pyramid of Cestius was hidden behind a high wall on the orders of Emperor Aurelian; this probably helped it survive throughout the centuries to come, even as other ancient monuments disappeared.
我们还知道，公元前三世纪，凯斯提乌斯金字塔被藏在奥里安皇帝的命令下一座高墙后面；这也许有助于它在今后几个世纪中生存，即使其他古迹消失。

By the Middle Ages, the pyramid was covered in vegetation and thick dirt, and popular myth had developed that it might be a tomb for one of the twin brothers Romulus and Remus, who were regarded as the men who had established the city of Rome.
到了中世纪，金字塔被植被和厚土覆盖，流行的神话已经发展出来，它可能是两个兄弟之一罗穆卢斯和雷穆斯的坟墓，他们被认为是建立罗马城的人。
Cestius’ actual tomb within the pyramid and the inscription identifying the pyramid as his weren’t rediscovered until the 1660s, when the pyramid underwent restoration.
凯斯提乌斯在金字塔内的实际墓穴和标明金字塔的碑文直到1660年代金字塔恢复了才被再次发现

During excavations, when trees and plants were cleared away, two marble bases were found in front of the pyramid, as well as fragments of bronze statues that had once stood on them, on either side of the pyramid.
在挖掘过程中，树木和植物被清除后，在金字塔前方发现了两个大理石基地，以及金字塔两侧曾经竖立的铜雕像碎片。
The people employed to excavate the pyramid did not find the urn that would have contained Cestius’ remains, but they did come across a tunnel.
受雇挖掘金字塔的人没有找到塞斯提乌斯遗骨的骨灰盒，但他们确实发现了一条隧道。
It was quite possible, therefore, that robbers had at some earlier time removed the contents of the tomb.
因此，抢劫者很可能在较早的时候将坟墓内的东西移走。
But while some of the features of Cestius’ tomb no longer exist, at least the pyramid itself has survived.
但尽管凯斯提乌斯墓的一些特征已经不复存在，但至少金字塔本身已经生存下来。

paragraphs.brief: 今天，凯斯提乌斯金字塔的根基就停留在街道下方，接近交通繁忙的交汇处，这样过往的游客和居民很容易看不到其全高度119英尺。
sentences: Today, the foundations of Cestius’ pyramid rest below street level near an intersection with heavy traffic, so that passing tourists and residents could easily fail to notice its full height of 119 feet.
今天，凯斯提乌斯金字塔的根基就停留在街道下方，接近交通繁忙的交汇处，这样过往的游客和居民很容易看不到其全高度119英尺。
Across the intersection is the Piramide station, located on Line B of the Rome Metro.
交叉路口是Piramid站位于罗马地铁B线上

In 2011, the Japanese clothing-company entrepreneur Yuzo Yagi, president of Yagi Tsusho Ltd, announced his intention to help the Italian government pay for an ambitious renovation of the Pyramid of Cestius.
2011年，日本服装公司企业家Yuzo Yagi宣布，他打算帮助意大利政府为大刀阔斧的Cestius金字塔的翻修支付费用。
‘It’s an act of gratitude,’ he later told journalists.
他后来告诉记者说："这是感激之事"
‘Our company has grown thanks to Italy.’
"我们的公司由于意大利而成长。"

Work began at the site shortly after Yagi signed an official agreement with the Special Superintendency for the Archaeological Heritage of Rome, and was completed ahead of schedule thanks to his 2-million-euro contribution.
工程在Yagi与罗马考古遗产特别监管局签署正式协议后不久就开始，由于他提供了200万欧元的捐款，工程提前完成。

paragraphs.brief: 正如考古学家Leonardo Guarnieri向记者解释的那样，官员们现在每月两次通过预订对新翻新的金字塔进行参观。
sentences: As archaeologist Leonardo Guarnieri explained to journalists, officials are now conducting tours of the newly renovated pyramid twice a month by reservation.
正如考古学家Leonardo Guarnieri向记者解释的那样，官员们现在每月两次通过预订对新翻新的金字塔进行参观。
Visitors who take advantage of the tour can make their way through a narrow corridor in order to enter the burial chamber itself.
利用参观的游客可以穿过狭小的走廊进入墓地本身。
It is within these walls that they can admire the frescoes: watercolour paintings typical of the time.
正是在这些墙内，他们能够欣赏壁画：典型的水色绘画。

In the chamber, it is possible to make out four frescoes of the winged Roman goddess of war, Victoria, a figure from Roman legend, as well as a series of vases, the type that would have been used for special rituals and purification purposes.
在室内，可以得出四幅有翅膀的罗马战争女神维多利亚的壁画，一个来自罗马传说的数字，以及一系列花瓶，这些花瓶本来可以用于特殊仪式和净化目的。
We know from the writings of earlier visitors that there used to be more here, but the majority have disappeared over time.
我们从以前的访客的著作中得知，这里曾经有较多的游客，但大多数人已经逐渐消失。
Only one problem remains now that the restoration is complete.
现在只有一个问题，即修复工作已经完成。
The white exterior of the Pyramid of Cestius will have to be cleaned every few months to remove the layer of urban pollution.
西斯提乌斯金字塔的白色外表每隔几个月必须清理一次才能消除城市污染层
A team of free-climbers will be employed to do the job, in order to avoid placing builders’ scaffolding around the newly welcoming monument.
将雇用一组自由建筑工来完成这项工作，以避免建筑工人在新欢迎的纪念碑周围架设脚架。

items.en: The Pyramid of Cestius has always been one of Rome’s most popular tourist attractions.
items.zh: 凯斯提乌斯金字塔一直是罗马最受欢迎的旅游景点之一。
items.why: 题干“has always been…最受欢迎”= 一直很火。原文说“从未获得那么多兴趣”,语义相反，故F。关键词对照: always been most popular © never attracted much interest.

items.en: The construction of the Pyramid was completed before Cestius’ death.
items.zh: 建造金字塔的工作在凯斯提乌斯死前就已完成。
items.why: 塞斯提乌斯要求工程在330天内完成，文章没有把竣工日期与他的死期相比较。

items.en: In the Middle Ages, people thought an original founder of Rome was buried in the Pyramid of Cestius.
items.zh: 在中世纪人们以为罗马的创始人被埋葬在凯斯提乌斯的金字塔里
items.why: 中世纪传说称塔中可能埋着罗慕路斯或雷穆斯，两人被视为罗马的创建者。

items.en: Today, the height of the Pyramid is something that tourists and residents immediately notice.
items.zh: 今天，金字塔的高度是游客和居民立即注意到的事情。
items.why: 塔基低于街面，附近车流繁忙，游客和居民经过时很容易忽略塔的高度。

items.en: Japanese businessman Yuzo Yagi was an admirer of both Italian and Egyptian architecture.
items.zh: 日本商人Yuzo Yagi是意大利和埃及建筑的崇拜者。
items.why: 八木雄三愿意资助修复这座金字塔，不能据此推断他同时喜爱意大利和埃及建筑。

items.en: The restoration of the Pyramid of Cestius, which was funded by Yuzo Yagi, finished earlier than expected.
items.zh: 由Yuzo Yagi资助的Cestius金字塔的修复工作比预期提前完成。
items.why: ahead of schedule =“早于预期”,与题干一致，故T。

items.en: Most of the original frescoes inside Cestius’ tomb have survived to this day.
items.zh: 塞斯提乌斯墓中的大部分原始壁画至今仍能存活下来。
items.why: 题干说“大多数幸存",原文为“大多数消失”,语义相反，故F。

items.en: it was made from ________, cement and marble
items.zh: 这座金字塔是用________、水泥和大理石建成的。
items.why: 笔记给出并列“,cement and marble”,与原文并列完全对应。用单数 brick (雅思常用搭配 : made from brick)。

items.en: its ________ is different to the pyramids found in Egypt
items.zh: 它的________与埃及金字塔的不同。
items.why: 回到对应内容“当你看到金字塔时，你所看到的一个东西就是它有多陡峭，所以凯斯提乌斯金字塔的形状与典型的埃及金字塔完全不同”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: it was originally built in the ________ as building tombs in the city was forbidden
items.zh: 由于城内禁止建造坟墓，这座陵墓最初建在________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“在建造时，由于罗马法律严格禁止在该市内安放坟墓，凯斯底斯金字塔本来会留在农村”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: In the 1660s, some broken ________ were found next to it
items.zh: 17世纪60年代，人们在它旁边发现了一些破碎的________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“在挖掘过程中，树木和植物被清除后，在金字塔前方发现了两个大理石基地，以及金字塔两侧曾经竖立的铜雕像碎片”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: the ________ inside the tomb suggests that robbers had been there
items.zh: 墓室里的________表明曾有盗墓者到过这里。
items.why: 回到对应内容“受雇挖掘金字塔的人没有找到塞斯提乌斯遗骨的骨灰盒，但他们确实发现了一条隧道”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: climbers are helping to get rid of signs of ________
items.zh: 攀登人员正在协助清除________留下的痕迹。
items.why: 回到对应内容“西斯提乌斯金字塔的白色外表每隔几个月必须清理一次才能消除城市污染层”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 第 5 段 · 第 2 句
第 3 段 · 第 6 句
points: 塞斯提乌斯要求工程在330天内完成，文章没有把竣工日期与他的死期相比较。
笔记给出并列“,cement and marble”,与原文并列完全对应。用单数 brick (雅思常用搭配 : made from brick)。
clauses: …, one notable monument there has never attracted nearly as much interest: the Pyramid of Cestius.
连接词 though 引出“Though Rome draws tourists from around the world to its many impressive sites”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 though 把这一层关系补进去。
The people employed to excavate the pyramid did not find the urn …, but they did come across a tunnel.
“that would have contained Cestius’ remains”修饰前面的 urn。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 urn，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: A 2,000-year-old pyramid in the city of Rome has been restored by archaeologists.
罗马城一个2000年的金字塔已经被考古学家修复了
